title: 기분 말하기: 기쁠 때, 불안할 때, 실망할 때
objective: By the end, you can choose the right word for a feeling of joy, anxiety, or disappointment and use it in a short sentence that gives the reason with -아/어서.
summary: Learn ten intermediate words for describing feelings of joy, anxiety, and disappointment in everyday situations.

task.title: Use the feeling words
task.line: Read each situation, then choose, fill in, or arrange the feeling word that fits it best.

words.meaning: to feel proud and satisfied with something you did
words.exampleMeaning: I made kimchi stew by myself and it tasted good, so I felt proud.

words.meaning: to feel excited and fluttery about something coming soon
words.example: 다음 주에 한국에 처음 가는데 벌써 설레요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to Korea for the first time next week, and I'm already excited.

words.example: 친구가 손으로 쓴 편지를 받고 정말 감동했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was really touched when I got a handwritten letter from my friend.

words.meaning: to feel uneasy, worried that something is wrong
words.example: 지갑을 어디에 뒀는지 생각이 안 나서 불안해요.
words.exampleMeaning: I can't remember where I put my wallet, so I feel uneasy.

words.meaning: to feel restless and anxious while waiting
words.example: 면접 결과를 기다리는 동안 너무 초조했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was so anxious while waiting for the interview results.

words.meaning: to feel nervous before something important
words.exampleMeaning: I always get nervous before a presentation.

words.meaning: to be disappointed when something is worse than you expected
words.exampleMeaning: The movie I was looking forward to was boring, so I was disappointed.

words.meaning: to feel sorry that something good is over or missed
words.exampleMeaning: It's a shame the trip is already over.

words.meaning: to feel upset when something bad happens
words.example: 새로 산 휴대폰 화면이 깨져서 너무 속상해요.
words.exampleMeaning: The screen of my new phone cracked, and I'm really upset.

words.meaning: to feel hurt or let down by someone close to you
words.example: 친구가 제 생일을 잊어버려서 좀 서운했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My friend forgot my birthday, so I felt a little hurt.

exercises: Choose the word that fits: ① 시험 결과가 나오기 전이라 마음이 (초조해요 / 뿌듯해요). ② 오랜 친구가 제 결혼식에 안 와서 (설렜어요 / 서운했어요). ③ 열심히 준비한 음식을 손님들이 다 먹어서 (서운했어요 / 뿌듯했어요).
Fill in the blank with the present-tense 해요 form of 설레다: 내일 첫 데이트가 있어서 마음이 ____.
Which feeling fits each situation? Choose from 실망하다, 긴장되다, 감동하다: ① 기다리던 콘서트 표를 못 샀어요. ② 사장님 앞에서 처음 발표해요. ③ 할머니가 보내 주신 선물을 받고 눈물이 났어요.
Fill in each blank with 불안하다 or 속상하다 in the past tense (-았/었어요): ① 밤늦게 혼자 모르는 길을 걸어서 좀 ____. ② 아끼던 컵을 떨어뜨려서 정말 ____.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 아쉬워요 / 못 해서 / 친구하고 / 인사를
answers: ① 초조해요 ② 서운했어요 ③ 뿌듯했어요
① 실망하다 ② 긴장되다 ③ 감동하다
친구하고 인사를 못 해서 아쉬워요. (also: 인사를 친구하고 못 해서 아쉬워요.)
